name: bibi
description: BibiGPT Codex plugin for summarizing videos, audio, and podcasts, extracting transcripts, and repackaging AV content into articles and short videos.

interface.shortDescription: Summarize videos, audio, and podcasts from Codex
interface.longDescription: Workflow skills and MCP server configuration for routing video/audio understanding work to BibiGPT: summarizing YouTube, Bilibili, TikTok, Twitter/X, Xiaohongshu, podcasts, and local media files; extracting transcripts and subtitles with timestamps; chapter-by-chapter breakdowns; turning long-form videos into articles, social posts, or TikTok-style vertical music videos; batch processing and multi-source research; managing a personal AV library with channels, feeds, collections, and notes; and exporting results to Notion, Obsidian, or local files.
defaultPrompt: Extract the transcript with timestamps from this podcast
Turn this video into a blog article
What's new across my subscribed channels?
